courthouses.name: Ronald Reagan Federal Building and U.S. Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Clerk's office: 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Mon–Fri; building: 7:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Mon–Fri (excluding court-observed holidays)
courthouses.note: Room 1053 is the clerk's office. Records Dept. (Southern Division): (714) 338-4746. The court publishes no fixed duty courtroom; magistrate courtrooms vary by daily calendar — check the court's Criminal Duty Calendar or ask defense counsel.

courthouses.name: Edward R. Roybal Federal Building and U.S. Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Clerk's office: 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Mon–Fri; building: 7:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Mon–Fri (excluding court-observed holidays)
courthouses.note: Western Division criminal duty has historically been held at Roybal (per court notices), but the location page lists no duty courtroom. Records Dept. (Western Division): (213) 894-3863. One-hour metered parking on Temple and San Pedro Streets 9 a.m.–6 p.m.

courthouses.name: Felicitas and Gonzalo Mendez United States Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Clerk's office: 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Mon–Fri; building: 7:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Mon–Fri (excluding court-observed holidays)
courthouses.note: This is the building at 350 W. 1st St. commonly called the First Street U.S. Courthouse; the court's site now lists it under the Mendez name. 'criminal' assumed true for a district courthouse — todo: confirm which criminal proceedings are held here.

courthouses.name: George E. Brown, Jr. Federal Building and United States Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Clerk's office: 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Mon–Fri; building: 7:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Mon–Fri (excluding court-observed holidays)
courthouses.note: Parking available at 3535 Twelfth St. Records Dept. (Eastern Division): (951) 328-4450.

pretrial.name: U.S. Pretrial Services — Central District of California (Santa Ana office)
pretrial.address: 411 W. Fourth St., Suite 4170, Santa Ana, CA 92701
pretrial.what: Interviews the defendant and checks records to help the judge decide release; if released, supervises release conditions (incl. location monitoring) and court attendance before trial. Combined U.S. Probation and Pretrial Services Office.

pretrial.what: Same combined Probation and Pretrial Services office; 213-894-3600 is also listed as the headquarters number.

cja_panel.what: Criminal Justice Act (CJA) Trial Attorney Panel: private attorneys appointed in cases where the Office of the Federal Public Defender has a conflict of interest or cannot otherwise accept the appointment. Serves the Western (LA), Southern (Santa Ana) and Eastern (Riverside) Divisions.
